description: This PHP source file defines a class 'PIMLeftMenuItemConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It configures a menu item for the left menu in the PIM (Personal Information Management) module of OrangeHRM, a Human Resource Management system. The class uses several traits for dependencies and includes a method 'configure' that determines whether to return a specific menu item based on the authenticated user's employee number, or to override the screen context.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuItemConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the left menu item for the PIM module, returning a specific menu item if the authenticated user matches the employee number, otherwise overriding the screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Returns a 'My Info' menu item if the current authenticated user's employee number matches the 'empNumber' attribute in the current request; otherwise, overrides the screen to 'viewEmployeeList' and returns null.

parameters.name: Screen $screen
parameters.description: The current screen context for configuration.
